page.overview:
What is Cortondo Gym?

The Cortondo Gym is a location introduced in Generation IX.

Cortondo Gym is a gymnasium located in the Paldea region, and the Gym Leader is Katy. This gym specializes in -type Pokémon. This gym is very close to Mesagoza, so many students at Naranja and Uva Academies go here to have their first Pokémon Battle at a gym.

The gym test requires the player to roll an olive to the finish line. You can ride on Koraidon to push it. There are also shortcuts, but to e able to use them, you have the battle the shortcut guard. The shortcut guard only has a Smoliv, so if you have a Fuecoco or Crocalor, it will be easier to battle the guards and the gym leader. Once you are finished with the Olive Roll, you may challenge Katy to a gym battle. By winning, the player can obtain the Bug Badge.

Katy owns a Nymble that can do Struggle Bug, so get a Houndour not only because it is part -type, but also because it outspeeds. Katy has a Tarountula that can use Assurance, but Hondour can be protected from this because it is part -type. Katy sends out her terastallized, Teddiursa, you may have a Tera Battle against Katy, as long as your Houndour terastallizes into a -type and not a -type, as is good against dark. If your Houndour is knocked out and you do not have a Fuecoco, bring in a -type like Staravia or Fletchling.
